heading: What I Build
subheading: Chatbots, custom apps, automation tools. These are solution demos showcasing my approach and capabilities. Real case studies coming soon.

categories.title: AI & Automation
categories.subtitle: Smart systems that work while you sleep
categories.description: From chatbots that speak your customers' language to workflows that eliminate repetitive tasks. I build AI that delivers measurable ROI. No buzzwords. No hype. Just tools that actually work.

projects.title: Hotel AI Customer Bot
projects.subtitle: Multilingual booking assistant for hotels and restaurants
projects.challenge: Hotels lose bookings when guests can't get quick answers about availability, pricing, and amenities outside business hours. Staff spend hours answering the same questions repeatedly.
projects.solution: A multilingual WhatsApp + web chatbot that handles room inquiries, processes bookings, and sends confirmation emails in multiple languages. Plugs into existing booking systems with zero disruption.
projects.results: This type of bot typically handles the majority of guest inquiries automatically, freeing staff to focus on in-person guest experience. Direct bookings increase as response time drops to seconds.

projects.title: AI Product Recommendations
projects.subtitle: Visual search that finds what customers can't describe
projects.challenge: E-commerce platforms with large catalogs struggle with text search. Customers can't find products when they don't know the exact name, leading to high cart abandonment.
projects.solution: Visual search powered by computer vision. Customers snap a photo or upload an image, and the system finds matching products instantly. Plus personalized recommendations based on browsing history.
projects.results: Visual search significantly improves product discovery, cutting the time to find items from minutes to seconds. Combined with personalized recommendations, it drives higher conversion and repeat visits.

projects.title: Demand Prediction Engine
projects.subtitle: Stop guessing inventory. Let the data decide.
projects.challenge: Distributors either overstock (tying up cash) or understock (losing sales). Seasonal patterns, supplier lead times, and thousands of SKUs make manual forecasting impractical.
projects.solution: A demand prediction system using historical sales, seasonality, market trends, and external factors like weather and events. Auto-generates purchase orders when stock hits reorder points.
projects.results: ML-driven forecasting dramatically reduces both stockouts and excess inventory. Procurement teams review AI recommendations instead of building spreadsheets from scratch.

projects.title: Automated Invoice Processing
projects.subtitle: Stop typing data by hand. Let the AI handle paperwork.
projects.challenge: Accounting firms process hundreds of invoices monthly by hand. Data entry errors cause payment delays. Each invoice takes minutes to process, plus time for corrections.
projects.solution: An OCR pipeline that scans invoices (PDF, photo, email), extracts key fields (amount, date, vendor, line items), and pushes data directly into accounting software. Human review only for edge cases.
projects.results: Processing time drops from minutes to seconds per invoice. Error rates fall dramatically. Teams redirect hours of manual work each week to higher-value advisory work.

categories.title: Custom App Development
categories.subtitle: Apps that fit your workflow, not the other way around
categories.description: Off-the-shelf software never quite fits. I build custom applications designed around how your team actually works. No subscription fees. You own the code.

projects.title: Commission-Free Reservation Engine
projects.subtitle: Your own booking system. No per-booking fees. Ever.
projects.challenge: Restaurants and hotels pay thousands monthly to third-party booking platforms in commissions. They don't own their customer data, and they're locked into someone else's ecosystem.
projects.solution: A custom reservation system with table management, waitlist, SMS reminders, and a customer database. Embeds into existing websites. Syncs with Google Calendar. Zero commission.
projects.results: Businesses typically save thousands annually by eliminating platform commissions. Owning customer data directly enables loyalty programs and targeted marketing that platforms don't allow.

projects.title: Headless E-commerce Platform
projects.subtitle: A store that scales with you, not against you
projects.challenge: Growing retailers outgrow platforms like Shopify. Custom checkout flows, B2B pricing tiers, and multi-warehouse inventory need features their current platform can't provide.
projects.solution: A headless e-commerce platform with custom admin, B2B/B2C split, multi-currency support, and warehouse-specific inventory. Full data migration without downtime.
projects.results: Custom checkout flows improve conversion. B2B portals unlock wholesale channels. Monthly platform costs drop from hundreds to just hosting fees, since you own the code.

projects.title: Inventory Management System
projects.subtitle: Know exactly what you have, where it is, in real-time
projects.challenge: Wholesalers managing inventory across multiple warehouses with Excel face constant stock count errors. Customers get "out of stock" calls after placing orders.
projects.solution: A real-time inventory system with barcode scanning, multi-location transfers, low-stock alerts, and customer order integration. Mobile app for warehouse floor use.
projects.results: Real-time tracking brings inventory accuracy close to 99%. Order fulfillment errors drop significantly. Staff spend far less time on manual stock counts.

projects.title: Supplier Management Portal
projects.subtitle: One place for orders, invoices, and communications
projects.challenge: Businesses coordinating with dozens of suppliers via email, phone, and WhatsApp lose orders, face invoice mismatches, and have no visibility into delivery timelines.
projects.solution: A supplier portal where vendors submit quotes, receive POs, confirm deliveries, and upload invoices. Real-time tracking from order to delivery to payment.
projects.results: Order disputes drop dramatically when everything is tracked in one system. Procurement teams save hours weekly on coordination. Payment cycles shorten significantly.

categories.title: Data & Analytics
categories.subtitle: Turn messy data into clear decisions
categories.description: Your business generates tons of data. Most of it sits in spreadsheets nobody opens. I build dashboards and analytics tools that surface the insights you actually need.

projects.title: Review Analytics Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Aggregate reviews across all platforms in one view
projects.challenge: Hotels and restaurants manage reviews across Google, Booking.com, TripAdvisor, and Facebook separately. No unified view, slow response to negative reviews, no trend visibility.
projects.solution: A centralized dashboard that aggregates reviews from all platforms, runs sentiment analysis, suggests AI-generated responses, and tracks trends over time across all locations.
projects.results: Unified review management cuts response time from days to hours. Sentiment analysis surfaces patterns that manual reading misses. Management gets real-time visibility across all properties.

projects.title: Unified E-commerce Analytics
projects.subtitle: Beyond Google Analytics. The metrics that matter.
projects.challenge: Online retailers have data scattered across Google Analytics, Shopify, ad platforms, and email tools. No single view. Can't answer "which channel is most profitable?"
projects.solution: A unified analytics platform pulling data from multiple sources. Custom attribution modeling, customer lifetime value tracking, cohort analysis, and automated weekly reports.
projects.results: Cross-channel visibility typically reveals significant wasted ad spend. Reallocating budget to top-performing channels drives meaningful improvements in marketing ROI.

projects.title: Customer Purchase Intelligence
projects.subtitle: Know your customers better than they know themselves
projects.challenge: B2B wholesalers with hundreds of customers treat them all the same. No visibility into purchase patterns, churn risk, or cross-sell opportunities. Decisions rely on gut feeling.
projects.solution: A customer intelligence dashboard with purchase frequency analysis, basket analysis, churn prediction, and rep-specific performance metrics. Automated alerts for at-risk accounts.
projects.results: Churn prediction identifies at-risk accounts before they leave. Cross-sell recommendations surface missed revenue opportunities. Sales teams get data-driven priorities instead of guesswork.

projects.title: Construction Client Portal
projects.subtitle: Clients see project progress without calling you
projects.challenge: Construction companies spend hours weekly answering client questions: "What's the status?" "When will phase 2 start?" Project managers drown in update calls.
projects.solution: A client portal with real-time project timelines, photo galleries, document storage, and milestone notifications. Clients self-serve their own updates.
projects.results: Status update calls drop dramatically when clients can check progress themselves. Project managers reclaim hours each week. Client satisfaction improves through transparency.

categories.title: Product Design
categories.subtitle: Beautiful interfaces that users actually understand
categories.description: Good design isn't decoration. It's how things work. I design products people want to use: clear interfaces, intuitive flows, and visuals that build trust. From wireframes to pixel-perfect handoff.

projects.title: Web Application Design
projects.subtitle: Complex functionality, simple interfaces
projects.challenge: Turning complex business requirements into interfaces that don't require a manual. Enterprise features with startup-level usability.
projects.solution: I design web applications with user research, information architecture, component libraries, and responsive layouts. From dashboard-heavy tools to customer-facing portals.
projects.results: Well-designed web apps see faster user onboarding and fewer support tickets. A clear component system also speeds up development and keeps the UI consistent as features grow.

projects.title: Mobile App Design
projects.subtitle: Native feel. Thumb-friendly everything.
projects.challenge: Mobile users are impatient. You have 3 seconds to make sense. Apps need to feel intuitive from first launch, no tutorials needed.
projects.solution: I design for iOS and Android with platform-specific patterns, gesture-based navigation, offline states, and performance-optimized assets. Touch targets that actually work.
projects.results: Platform-native design patterns make apps feel familiar from the first tap. Thoughtful gesture support and proper touch targets directly improve retention and app store ratings.

projects.title: SaaS Platform Design
projects.subtitle: Products that sell themselves through great UX
projects.challenge: SaaS lives or dies on usability. Free trial users need to see value immediately. Onboarding needs to be frictionless. Features need to be discoverable.
projects.solution: I design SaaS products with conversion-focused onboarding, progressive disclosure, empty states that educate, and upgrade flows that don't feel pushy.
projects.results: Good onboarding and feature discovery directly impact trial-to-paid conversion. When users can find and use features without friction, churn drops and expansion revenue grows.

projects.title: E-commerce Design
projects.subtitle: Stores that convert browsers into buyers
projects.challenge: Most e-commerce sites look the same. Product pages that don't sell. Checkouts with unnecessary steps. Cart abandonment over 70%.
projects.solution: I design e-commerce experiences with scroll-stopping product pages, frictionless checkout, trust signals that work, and upsells that feel helpful not pushy.
projects.results: Streamlined checkout flows and better product pages directly improve conversion rates. Every unnecessary step removed from checkout recovers abandoned carts.
